questions.question: In which year was the Rajya Sabha formed?
questions.solution:
**The Rajya Sabha** was formed in __**1952**__.

 
• **The first session of the Rajya Sabha **was held on 13 May 1952.
 
• The Rajya Sabha or the Council of States is **the upper house of the bicameral Indian Parliament. **
 
• It currently has a** maximum membership of 245**, of which 233 are elected by the legislatures of the States and Union Territories by means of a single transferable vote through the Open Ballot, while the President may appoint 12 members for their contributions to art, literature, science and social services.
 
• **The Vice-President of India (now **Jagdeep Dhankhar**) is the ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha, who presides over the sessions.
 
• The Deputy Chairman,** who is elected from among the members of the House, shall take care of the day-to-day affairs of the House in the absence of the Chairman.

questions.question: Adult humans generally have ______ molar teeth.
questions.solution:

• Humans have four types of teeth: **incisors, canines, premolars and molars, **each of which has a different purpose.
 
• **The incisors** cut the food, the **canines** cut the food, and the **molars** and **premolars** crush the food.

questions.question: Saliva contains a digestive enzyme called _______, which begins to break down some carbohydrates present in the food before going down the mouth.
questions.solution:
**Saliva contains **a digestive enzyme called __**Amylase**__, which begins to break down some carbohydrates present in the **food before going down the mouth.**

 
• **Amylase** is an enzyme that **catalyzes starch hydrolysis into sugars. **
 
• It is present in human saliva and in some other mammals, where the **chemical process of digestion begins**.
 
• Foods that produce significant quantities of starch but little sugar, such as rice and potatoes, can have a mildly sweet flavour when they are chewed as amylase degrades some of their starch into sugar.
 
• **Lipase** is an enzyme that catalyzes fat hydrolysis.
 
• **Pepsin** is an endopeptidase, which breaks down proteins into smaller amino acids.
 
• **Trypsin** is an enzyme that allows us to digest proteins.

questions.question: The Sepoy Mutiny of 1857 started in ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Meerut**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The Sepoy Mutiny of 1857 started in Meerut.**

 
• It was a major but ultimately unsuccessful uprising in India in 1857–58 against the rule of the British East India Company, acting on behalf of the British Crown as the sovereign power.
 
• **The rebellion began on May 10, 1857**, in the form of a mutiny of the Company's army in the garrison town of Meerut, 64 km northeast of Delhi (now Old Delhi).
 
• It then erupted into other mutinies and civil rebellions mainly in the upper Gangetic plains and central India, although there were also incidents of revolt in the far north and east.
 
• The rebellion posed a considerable threat to British power in that region and was contained only by the defeat of the rebels in **Gwalior on 20 June 1858.**
